**Triage cross-link (no label change, no claim).** #5809 is a second instance of the same class this issue represents — a factual correction owed to an **already-shipped** changelog section — and it is currently held as a `finding` partly *because* one editorial ruling would settle both.

Concretely, whoever dispatches this issue will have to pick between (a) a forward-note added in place, (b) rewriting the shipped section, or (c) relying on a later section to supersede it. That choice is the whole of #5809's open question too (`packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:87`, the `## 17.0.0-rc.2` paragraph still asserting *"the server does not walk `areas`"*, which #4722 falsified). Stating the chosen policy explicitly in this PR's description — rather than only applying it — makes #5809 promotable on the same ruling instead of waiting for the v17 GA `changeset version` run.

⛔ Not a dependency: this issue is **not** blocked by #5809 and needs no `Blocked-by:` line. Same boundary applies to both: handling stops at `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` and never touches `content/docs/releases/`.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine(#5474 试点),不构成认领。

**Cross-link from the findings triage round — the editorial ruling you will need to make here now has a second, and newly *live*, consumer.**

**#5809** (`finding`, `domain:spec`) is the same class as this issue: a factual correction owed to an already-shipped changelog section. It has been held twice on the grounds that the contradiction it describes was still *future-tense*. **As of this round that is no longer true**, and the change is worth knowing before you settle the policy here:

- `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` now has `## 17.0.0-rc.4` and `## 17.0.0-rc.5` sections (it did not ~10 h ago);
- the **rc.2** section still states, in the present tense, *"per-item gating inside an area is enforced by the shell only, because the server does not walk `areas`"* (`:5774`);
- the **rc.4** section (entry `e4c8b6c`, from #5337 / PR #5796) quotes that exact sentence and states it has not held since #4722, with the `filterAppForUser` / `filterNav` evidence (`:5349`);
- and `.changeset/app-area-fail-open-gates-removed.md` is still unconsumed, so GA will add a **third** statement to the same file.

So one `CHANGELOG.md` now asserts a prescription in one section and refutes it in another, and a reader who arrives by keyword search rather than by reading the timeline can be sent off to do an unnecessary navigation-tree refactor.

**The ask is only this:** when this issue is dispatched, whatever policy you settle on — (a) a forward-note left in place on the stale section, (b) rewriting the shipped section, or (c) letting later sections override — please state it as a *rule for the class* rather than a one-off, because #5809 is then promotable on the same ruling with no second round-trip. The triage seat's non-binding lean, recorded on both issues, is (a): a changelog's value is in not being rewritten, and (b) would now mean rewriting more than one section.

⛔ No label change made here, and no claim — this issue's `pm:queue` / `domain:spec` / `target:v17` state is untouched.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。
